title: Haken-type decomposition for rational maps
exact_target: Develop a Haken-type decomposition for these rational maps, including construction of maps with disconnected Julia sets by surgery from maps with connected Julia sets.

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath: A Curated Collection of Open Mathematics Problems, record 5300086 (AMR-052-0086). CC BY 4.0.
